publication_gate: A receipt becomes public only after human review, static-content serialization, release validation, and a Git commit. Database state cannot publish directly.

receipt_types.name: Change Note
receipt_types.use_when: Reviewed evidence materially changes a public record without correcting an error.
receipt_types.required_effect: Name the prior state, current state, evidence boundary, affected records, and reversible publication action.

receipt_types.name: Watch Note
receipt_types.use_when: A source check changes the watch posture or next artifact but does not yet support a public-record state change.
receipt_types.required_effect: Name the checked source, new watch condition, exact next artifact, and next check date.

receipt_types.name: Correction
receipt_types.use_when: A reviewed public claim, date, identity, denominator, or interpretation is inaccurate.
receipt_types.required_effect: Preserve the prior claim, corrected claim, evidence, affected surfaces, and correction date.

receipt_types.name: No Material Change
receipt_types.use_when: A bounded source check finds no artifact that satisfies the exact publication gate.
receipt_types.required_effect: Identify the pages or artifacts reviewed, state what remains missing, retain the prior record state, and set the next check date without claiming nonexistence.

receipts.prior_state: The DARPA result signal was In Review pending an official measured-results artifact.
receipts.current_state: The signal remains In Review; the source profile now records the August 11 canonical-page check.
receipts.bounded_finding: The canonical DARPA challenge page links an event guide and scoreboard surface, but the reviewed DARPA page does not publish a final results table, winner, measured scores, or prize decisions.
receipts.evidence_boundary: This decision is limited to the canonical DARPA challenge page and official DARPA surfaces reviewed on August 11. It does not establish that results do not exist, were not announced, or will not be published.
receipts.publication_effect: Publish the dated no-material-change receipt and source freshness update; do not promote, duplicate, correct, archive, or close the signal.
